platform: Apple M4 Pro, macOS arm64, one thread
scope: Direct built-in CHAR_LENGTH/CHARACTER_LENGTH of qualified native UPPER/LOWER primitive ASCII results. Includes total integer/BOOLEAN text, direct DECIMAL truth/predicate text and qualified Flink 2.2 primitive PRINTF. General Unicode, unverified producers and further consumers retain their prior routes.

method.input: Equal GenericRowData/BinaryRowData and Arrow, signed integer extrema, BOOLEAN, compact/noncompact DECIMAL truth/predicates, modern/legacy casts and qualified primitive ASCII formatting; both NULL modes.
method.native_timer: Starts/stops inside Rust after import and before export, retaining production Calc, output consumption, allocation, conversions and intrinsic callbacks. Initial JNI/import/export and perimeter transposes are outside this prepared operation only.
method.previous: Actual preceding encoder 519f221f, identical common fixture, production TableConfig/context and byte-identical release DSO/executable. Before requires a JVM evaluator; candidate requires empty evaluators. Compiler setup is outside timing.
method.pipeline: Twelve million-row bounded row-source/blackhole configurations, one thread, two warmups and five alternating stock/native measurements each. Submission/startup, JNI and both transposes retained. Surrounding JVM startup is outside the job timer.
method.fixture_configuration: All successful signatures use the production context-aware scalar encoder even when output is numeric. This passes the same TableConfig/legacy mode used by stock into inner character casts. The old result-type heuristic failed to configure numeric length outputs before any trial; no timings from that failed registration are used. The explicit rejected-signature fallback control retains its diagnostic path.

native_runtime_qualification.method: No native source/build change. Frozen byte-identical DSO/executable retain archived 912-core-test qualification, not a new Rust run. Fresh SQL/Java, four unchanged released character-length stock oracles and all measured controls use this runtime.

limitations: Only direct length of the existing locale-independent primitive UPPER/LOWER proof is added. General Unicode, bounded text casts, fallible/stateful/unverified producers and dependent expressions retain their prior routes.
PRINTF is absent from released Flink 1.18; those formatter matrix cells run only on 2.2.
All tiny and whole-job losses, independent stock drift, allocation probes and variability are retained. Bulk qualification is not universal full-job acceleration.
Hosted suites must qualify the exact pushed head. Historical per-function records are not relabeled as fresh whole-PR validation.

pilot.note: Four-cell admission pilot uses the same scalar encoder/runtime. Final common fixture only removes unreachable failure-control branches outside either operation. Its original source/bytecode hashes and all samples are retained.
